name: 29634 · Clemson, SC
findings: ZIP 29634 (Clemson) has 36 nonprofit organizations. 23 of them (64%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 23 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 29634 (Clemson) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
96% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
